'''Tadeusz Czeżowski''' (July 26, 1889 – March 28, 1981) was a Polish [[philosopher]] and [[logician]]. He is considered one of the most prominent members of the [[Lwów–Warsaw school|Lviv-Warsaw School]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite book|last=Czeżowski|first=Tadeusz|title=Knowledge, Science, and Values: A Program for Scientific Philosophy|publisher=Rodopi|year=2000|isbn=978-90-420-1433-6|location=Amsterdam|pages=7|language=en}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Czeżowski was born in [[Vienna]], [[Austria-Hungary]] on July 26, 1889.<ref>{{Cite book|last=Porębski|first=Czesław|title=Lectures on Polish Value Theory|publisher=BRILL|year=2019|isbn=978-90-04-39110-9|location=Leiden|pages=122|language=en}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite book|last=Garrido|first=Ángel|title=The Lvov-Warsaw School. Past and Present|last2=Wybraniec-Skardowska|first2=Urszula|publisher=Birkhäuser|year=2018|isbn=978-3-319-65429-4|location=Cham|pages=133|language=en}}</ref> He was the son of a high-ranking state official a previous Prefect who later became the Counsellor of the Governorate of Galicia.<ref name=":0" /> In 1907, he studied philosophy, mathematics, and physics at the [[University of Lviv]].<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" /> His mother, Helena Kusche, was considered part of the ''petite bourgeoisie'' of the city.<ref name=":1" /> He became a student of [[Kazimierz Twardowski]], who conferred to Czeżowski his doctorate in philosophy in 1914 after completing his dissertation entitled, ''Teoria klas'' (Theory of Classes).<ref name=":0" /> He also became a member of the [[Lwów–Warsaw School of Logic]].

After qualifying as mathematics and physics teacher, he started teaching in a Lviv grammar school in 1912.<ref name=":1" /> From 1923 to 1939 he was a professor at [[Stefan Batory University]] in [[Vilnius]], [[Lithuania]], and from 1945 to 1960 a professor at [[Nicolaus Copernicus University in Toruń]], [[Poland]]. In 1948 he became editor of the magazine ''Ruch Filozoficzny''. He died in [[Toruń]] in 1981.<ref name=":1" />

He was named a member of the [[Righteous Among the Nations]] in 1963.<ref>{{cite web
 |url=http://db.yadvashem.org/righteous/righteousName.html?language=en&itemId=4039646
 |title=The Righteous Among the Nations
 |last=
 |first=
 |date=
 |website=
 |publisher=Yad Vashem
 |access-date=February 17, 2018
 |quote= }}</ref>

==Works==
* ''O metafizyce, jej kierunkach i zagadnieniach'' (On Metaphysics, its directions and problems) (1948)
* ''Logika'' (1949)
* ''Odczyty filozoficzne'' (1958 and 1969)
* ''Filozofia na rozdrożu'' (1966)
* ''Pisma z etyki i teorii wartości'' (1989)
* ''Knowledge, Science, and Values. A Program for Scientific Philosophy'' Edited by Leon Gumanski, Amsterdam, Rodopi, 2000
